negative_results.claim_refuted: Executable loop schedules can be normalized as unordered set-like identity regardless of update policy.
negative_results.evidence: 27,007/30,000 sequential coupled schedule permutations changed outputs while an unsafe set-like schedule hash collided in all 27,007 changed-output cases.
negative_results.scope: Synthetic deterministic coupled-loop proxy; production FRANK runtime still requires target replication.

negative_results.claim_refuted: FRANK loop-of-loops currently forces a new first-class ClayCode loop primitive.
negative_results.evidence: Current needs are representable as typed loop state + explicit schedule/update policy + generic control-flow/effect machinery; no executable counterexample requiring new loop syntax was found.
negative_results.scope: Absence of current evidence is not proof of impossibility; keep falsifier open.

negative_results.claim_refuted: Textual or declared effect intent can confer external execution authority.
negative_results.evidence: 30,000 capability trials produced 0 forged accepts when authority required a valid capability token; independent WASI capability design likewise separates granted capability from ordinary text/syntax.
negative_results.scope: Mechanism-level support; production ClayCode gateway still requires target validation.
